title: 二叉树的所有路径
summary: 返回二叉树中所有从根到叶子的路径，每条路径用箭头连接节点值。
insight: 深度优先沿路径追加当前值，只有到叶子时才把完整路径加入答案。
pitfalls: 左右子树的输出顺序保持从左到右

solutions.title: DFS 构造路径字符串
solutions.idea: 递归参数携带父路径字符串，进入节点时追加当前值。
steps: 叶子加入答案，否则递归左右孩子

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> binaryTreePaths(TreeNode root){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();dfs(root,"",answer);return answer;}private void dfs(TreeNode node,String path,List<String> answer){if(node==null)return;String current=path.isEmpty()?String.valueOf(node.val):path+"->"+node.val;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null)answer.add(current);else{dfs(node.left,current,answer);dfs(node.right,current,answer);}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun binaryTreePaths(root:TreeNode?):List<String>{val answer=mutableListOf<String>();fun dfs(node:TreeNode?,path:String){if(node==null)return;val current=if(path.isEmpty())node.`val`.toString() else path+"->"+node.`val`;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null)answer.add(current)else{dfs(node.left,current);dfs(node.right,current)}};dfs(root,"");return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void dfs(TreeNode* node,string path,vector<string>& answer){if(!node)return;string current=path.empty()?to_string(node->val):path+"->"+to_string(node->val);if(!node->left&&!node->right)answer.push_back(current);else{dfs(node->left,current,answer);dfs(node->right,current,answer);}}public:vector<string> binaryTreePaths(TreeNode* root){vector<string> answer;dfs(root,"",answer);return answer;} };
